record.name: Cameroon
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Cameroon adopted a National AI Strategy in July 2025; a proposed AI authority and presidential AI council are reported as not yet established, and no evaluation body is described.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. The retrieved official MINPOSTEL procurement notice commissions a national AI strategy and roadmap with governance/coordination arrangements. It is a strategy-development study, not a study of an institute for the safety of advanced models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged. A recorded query uses site. rather than the valid site: operator; it was a general search, not a reliable domain restriction.

searches.query: Cameroun institut sécurité intelligence artificielle évaluation modèles gouvernement
Cameroon national AI safety security institute advanced model evaluation proposal government

check.language_note: The recorded fr query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged. English is also an official language; its English queries are marked accordingly.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The Lawyers Hub desk-research profile was read, but independence of its underlying citations from the paired national or press source was not verified. It is not counted as a second evidence origin. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: Official ministry procurement notice describes the national AI strategy-development mandate and governance/coordination work.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications (MINPOSTEL)
related_bodies.role: It is responsible for CONIA consultations and development of a national AI strategy. Its 2024 account records a recommendation for a strategy roadmap, not a model-evaluation institute.

related_bodies.name: AI authority and Presidential AI Council (proposed)
related_bodies.role: They are proposed in the strategy according to the secondary profile. They had not been gazetted as of June 2026.

record.notes: MINPOSTEL's 2024 CONIA account was retrieved and records consultations and a recommended AI-strategy roadmap. Lawyers Hub and Osiris's republication of Ecofin reporting supply the later governance context, including the strategy's unveiling on 7 July 2025 (Osiris) and Lawyers Hub's account that it was formally adopted that day; the strategy text was not found. The earlier allAfrica request returned HTTP 403. Searched in French and English.

next_check.reason: Check whether the proposed AI authority is created and has an evaluation mandate.
